source:
@@U02842@@
She’s looking back! I knew she would!

@@U02844@@
He’s astonished. A miracle’s happened to him.

@@U02846@@
Not to her. She’s seen it before.

@@U02848@@
She’s turned with great dignity to face him.

@@U02850@@
She'll be playing tutor to him now. Men are such fools in these matters. And he fancies himself the first.

@@U02852@@
Let’s not argue. Majestically marvelous!

@@U02854@@
The slut! How vulgar!

@@U02856@@
I sure wouldn't mind trading places with him!

@@U02858@@
She can snare any man she wants.

@@U02860@@
That trinket’s been passed through too many hands; even the gilding’s worn thin.

@@U02862@@
She’s been at it since she was ten.
translation:
@@U02842@@
她正在回头看！我就知道她会的！

@@U02844@@
他很惊讶。奇迹发生在他身上。

@@U02846@@
不是对她。她以前见过。

@@U02848@@
她非常有尊严地转身面对他。

@@U02850@@
她现在将担任他的导师。在这些问题上，男人真是愚蠢至极。他幻想自己是第一。

@@U02852@@
我们不要争论了。雄伟奇妙！

@@U02854@@
荡妇！多么粗俗啊！

@@U02856@@
我当然不介意和他交换位置！

@@U02858@@
她可以俘获任何她想要的男人。

@@U02860@@
那件小饰品已经经过了太多人的手；就连镀金都磨损得稀薄了。

@@U02862@@
她从十岁起就开始这样做了。
